transport: PostgreSQL with strict certificate validation against the official Supabase CA
scope: Canonical SAVINGS_RUNTIME_V1 operations of types WITHDRAW and EXTRAORDINARY_WITHDRAWAL, with canonical participants

liveSettlementSemantics.verifiedAssignment: The public operation wrapper calls the existing private writer, whose SETTLED update records actual capital and yield in requested_capital_amount and requested_yield_amount and records settled_at.
liveSettlementSemantics.scope: Existing function definitions inspected read-only; no settlement invoked.

limitations: Production contained one qualifying operational withdrawal at review time; scale and pagination over 522 requests were verified by the separate isolated PostgreSQL test.
Security checks used the authenticated SQL role and the existing administrator identity inside a read-only transaction; browser HTTP verification is recorded separately.
